subject.title: fix(security): bind External SSH credential destinations

question: Should this PR's source-bound trusted user-config contract be accepted as the External SSH credential-boundary fix, including fail-closed behavior for legacy or repository-only External SSH routing?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent and security-positive, but it changes upgrade behavior and adds trusted opt-in config for a security boundary that needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept the trusted-config contract
options.body: Merge after maintainer approval that External SSH credentials require exact trusted user-config approval or validated routing state before normal acquire/resolve/list can use them.

options.title: Require a softer compatibility path
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves current behavior by default and adds an explicit strict mode or migration before fail-closing existing External workflows.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Do not merge this PR if maintainers do not want new External SSH trusted opt-ins or source-bound provider-output approval in core.

recommendation.title: Accept the trusted-config contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer approval that External SSH credentials require exact trusted user-config approval or validated routing state before normal acquire/resolve/list can use them.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history on the documented security boundary and adjacent credential-destination framework.
